annotations.title: Find artworks, artists, museums and articles by name or keywords

description: Full-text search across artworks, artists, museums and articles at once (maximum 10 results per model, merged by relevance). Use it when you know a name or keywords and want the objects; to answer a question from what our texts say, use search_sections_semantically. Each result carries pk, model, title, artist_name, city, country, date_born, date_death, url, image_url (absolute URL of the large image, null when there is none), meta_description and score.

language.description: Site language code (2 letters, e.g. "en", "fr"). Default "en".

query.description: Words to search across all four catalogs.
